profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record, tagged EdgeConneX PHX02 Data Center, sits in Mesa, Arizona, within EdgeConneX broader Phoenix-area market. EdgeConneX own Phoenix market page, however, does not list an operational facility named PHX02, describing only one active building in that market, referred to as PHX01 and located in nearby Tempe, plus roughly 50 acres of undeveloped land in Mesa that the company states is available for a future build-to-suit data center. That leaves this record status genuinely unclear: it may represent a planned or since-built Mesa facility not yet reflected on EdgeConneX current site, an internal designation not published publicly, or a naming discrepancy in how this location was originally mapped, and no capacity, square footage, or opening date can be confirmed for it as a result. EdgeConneX is a US-based edge and build-to-suit data center operator founded in 2009 and headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, with regional headquarters in Amsterdam and Singapore. The company was acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020, and its current board also includes a representative of Sixth Street, an investment firm, alongside EQT partners, though exact ownership percentages are not disclosed on EdgeConneX own site. EdgeConneX describes its footprint today as more than 90 data centers across more than 60 markets in over 20 countries on four continents, and it operates a joint venture called AdaniConneX in India alongside a strategic investment in the China-based operator Chayora. The company model centers on build-to-suit and build-to-density facilities, ranging from small edge deployments to very large campuses, typically serving cloud, AI and high-performance computing, content-delivery, and network or ISP tenants, though specific named tenants are rarely disclosed publicly, consistent with the lack of tenant information found for this Mesa record.
profile.capacity_note: Not published. This record likely corresponds to an undeveloped land parcel rather than a completed building.

reading.body:
This record identifies a Mesa, Arizona location within EdgeConneX's Phoenix market, but its operational status is unclear. EdgeConneX's own Phoenix market page lists only one active facility in the region, PHX01 in Tempe, plus approximately 50 acres of undeveloped land in Mesa available for future build-to-suit development. No published capacity, completion date, or tenant information exists for this Mesa location, and it may represent either a planned facility not yet reflected in public materials, an internal designation, or a mapping discrepancy in how the site was originally recorded.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities but only 4 with published power specifications, totaling 512 MW. This Mesa location is not among them. Without confirmed capacity figures, it cannot be ranked against other sites in the state or assessed for its contribution to Arizona's compute infrastructure. Until EdgeConneX publishes operational specs or a building completion date for this site, it remains invisible to power-constrained AI infrastructure planning.

The operator is EdgeConneX, a US-based build-to-suit specialist owned by EQT Infrastructure with investment from Sixth Street, operating over 90 facilities across 20 countries. EdgeConneX typically serves AI, cloud, and high-performance computing tenants through custom deployments, but no tenant or use case information is published for this particular Mesa site.
